description: A nested parse's answer depends on where each token of the span begins and ends in the original text, since text() of a part of the span reads it; two spans with the same whole text and the same tokens but different boundaries inside do not share an answer (engine §4, nested parses).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text "L" first "R" second
%rule first $a("a") $b("a") "a" $d("a")
%emits $a <"A">, $b <"A">, $d <"A">
%rule second $a("a") "a" $c("a") $d("a")
%emits $a <"A">, $c <"A">, $d <"A">
```
documents.b.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x(triple) $y(triple)
%conditions matches($x, probe), ¬matches($y, probe)
%rule triple A A A
%rule probe $p(pair) A
%conditions text($p) = "aa"
%rule pair A A
```
